## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A nine-fascicle Suí-period line-by-line commentary by Jízàng 吉藏 on Kumārajīva's *[Móhē bōrě bōluómì jīng (T223)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0004)*. The contents-list at the head of fascicle 1 shows the structure: fascicle 1 — *Xuányì* 玄意 (esoteric-meaning prologue); fascicle 2 — missing in the transmitted text (the head-note explicitly notes 「但欠此卷」 "only this fascicle is missing"); fascicles 3–9 — line-by-line commentary on the chapters of T223 (序品 / 奉鉢品 / etc.).

**Abstract**

X451 is the principal Sānlùn line-by-line commentary on the *Mahāprajñāpāramitā* in Chinese, complementing the programmatic *[Dàpǐn jīng yóuyì (T1696)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0007)* which gives the doctrinal-philosophical core. Together with [T1696](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0007), X451 constitutes Jízàng's two-tier commentary on T223 — programmatic and detailed — and is foundational for Sānlùn / Chinese-Mādhyamika *prajñā* exegesis. The work is dateable to Jízàng's documented active period (580–623). The transmitted text is partial: fascicle 2 is missing throughout the manuscript transmission.
